attribution.title: Konya Sahip Ata Vakıflar Eserleri Müzesi exterior 4509
attribution.author: Dosseman
attribution.credit: Own work
attribution.description:
The gate in full splendour. 
This is a complex (külliye) that consists of a mosque, that can be reached through an impressive gate with minaret attached. The medrese part of the complex houses a fine museum that exhibits 220 ethnographic items. In that museum one can also see a number of tiled sarcophagy of great quality. This is one of some pictures of the exterior, mainly the aforementioned gate and minaret, with some details.
